title: Butter Shortbread
description: Crisp, melt-in-the-mouth Scottish-style shortbread made with just butter, sugar, flour and salt, baked low until pale golden.

image.alt: Pale golden shortbread cut into fingers

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 325F oven} and line the pan with parchment.
Beat the butter, sugar and vanilla until smooth and creamy but not fluffy, {time 1-2 min}.
Add the flour and salt and mix on low just until the dough comes together in clumps.
Press the dough evenly into the pan, prick it all over with a fork and score it into {count 16} pieces with a knife. Sprinkle with the extra sugar.
Bake until pale golden at the edges and set in the middle, {time 30-35 min}. Re-cut along the scores while warm, then cool completely in the pan before lifting out.

notes: Good butter makes all the difference here, since it’s the main flavor.
Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight tin.
